docker_compose_file:
# base miner CVM — AGENT_CHALLENGE.md §9 (challenge_scoring_version=2)
# Secrets: file mounts under /run/base only. Never put secret values in environment.
# LAUNCH_TOKEN: only the hash is measured (D11). Miner funds their own Phala account.
# Work-receipt: private key file-mounted; public key published for challenge pin (D19).
# Docker: measured socket-proxy only; agent must not mount docker.sock (D4 / §9.1.1).
# Packs: named volume at pack_root; catalog URL for on-demand fetch.
services:
  socket-proxy:
    image: tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy@sha256:1f5038b54f06c3e18422902cf00ba21803d1c97805aae032e5e6673d532d3459
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CONTAINERS: "1"
      IMAGES: "1"
      POST: "1"
      ALLOW_START: "1"
      ALLOW_STOP: "1"
      NETWORKS: "1"
      INFO: "1"
      AUTH: "0"
      BUILD: "0"
      EXEC: "0"
      VOLUMES: "0"
      SWARM: "0"
      SERVICES: "0"
      SYSTEM: "0"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
  agent:
    image: ghcr.io/baseintelligence/base/base-agent@sha256:b5e6081f352c44cf9374c0b5d5d15c938892e0a05bfa0cc36c04ac19d2ae3de2
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - socket-proxy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      BASE_NETUID: "1"
      BASE_MINER_HOTKEY_FILE: "/run/base/miner_hotkey"
      BASE_LAUNCH_TOKEN_HASH: "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
      BASE_RECEIPT_SK_FILE: "/run/base/receipt_sk"
      BASE_RECEIPT_PUBLIC_KEY: "a0464947d2669f0eddbcdb1329209c4302963b81e5bf181b9af27998fba08438"
      BASE_DOCKER_BASE: "http://socket-proxy:2375"
      BASE_ENVIRONMENT_IMAGE: "bash@sha256:3bee76a96d86d5d2d5efc7c1c570e5a7c95db22348a26944e0e546fa174e3324"
      BASE_PACK_ROOT: "/var/lib/base/packs"
      BASE_PACK_CATALOG_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:8090"
      BASE_TRUSTED_CHALLENGE_PUBKEY: "f2e4965a6a99b75b4212bd45790c496e9665c0e1247e373d9dca3b36413fbd45"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: miner_hotkey
        target: /run/base/miner_hotkey
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: launch_token
        target: /run/base/launch_token
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: receipt_sk
        target: /run/base/receipt_sk
        read_only: true
      - packs:/var/lib/base/packs
  attest-helper:
    image: ghcr.io/baseintelligence/base/base-attest-helper@sha256:deb28d9dfd43d735372e177b6b621730bf145a2069b67f420aa07db18689e0bf
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8081:8081"
    environment:
      BASE_LAUNCH_TOKEN_HASH: "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
      BASE_MINER_HOTKEY_FILE: "/run/base/miner_hotkey"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: miner_hotkey
        target: /run/base/miner_hotkey
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: launch_token
        target: /run/base/launch_token
        read_only: true
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
volumes:
  packs:
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /dstack
: > /dstack/launch_token
printf '\x00\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07\x08\x09\x0a\x0b\x0c\x0d\x0e\x0f\x10\x11\x12\x13\x14\x15\x16\x17\x18\x19\x1a\x1b\x1c\x1d\x1e\x1f' > /dstack/miner_hotkey
printf '\xdc\x28\xd9\xa6\xfb\x26\x94\x3b\xf4\x96\xe0\x37\x22\xc5\x33\x77\xb5\x3a\xff\xe9\xec\x84\xc4\xd2\xae\xde\x2f\xdd\x0d\x9c\x48\x21' > /dstack/receipt_sk
if chown 65532:65532 /dstack/miner_hotkey /dstack/receipt_sk /dstack/launch_token 2>/dev/null; then
  chmod 0400 /dstack/miner_hotkey /dstack/receipt_sk
  chmod 0444 /dstack/launch_token
else
  chmod 0444 /dstack/miner_hotkey /dstack/receipt_sk /dstack/launch_token
fi
ls -la /dstack/miner_hotkey /dstack/launch_token /dstack/receipt_sk
echo "pre-launch secrets materialised ok"
